test_title: PYST 22: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Consider the following statements and identify the logical relationship.

I. The municipal corporation initiated a massive waste segregation drive.

II. A large number of residents are still disposing of mixed waste in public bins. ?

options.text: I is the cause and II is the effect
II is the cause and I is the effect
Both are effects of the same cause

solution: Given statements: I. The municipal corporation initiated a massive waste segregation drive. This statement addresses the initiative taken by the municipal corporation.
